name: Unidentified Interdictor-class Star Destroyer
wookieepedia_title: Unidentified Interdictor-class Star Destroyer (ambush of Gray Flight)
description: An Imperial Interdictor-class Star Destroyer took part in an operation to ambush Gray Flight. The ship deployed its interdiction field, trapping the flight. The Rebel fighters then destroyed eleven TIE/IN interceptors and turned their attention to the Interdictor. Gray Leader Leia Organa ordered her wingman to target their proton torpedoes on her transponder as she flew at the ship. She jettisoned the transponder next to the Interdictor, and the torpedoes impacted its gravity well projectors, disrupting them and allowing the Rebels to escape into hyperspace.
